name: Q-Force – Group chat
description: Several assistants discuss a topic in turn, with brakes and a summary.
long_description: In the group chat several connected assistants discuss a topic in turn, each with an optional role. Brakes keep it under control: rounds, contributions, length, time and tokens, a pause per round, stop on agreement or repetition. You can interject at any time; at the end an assistant writes a summary. Per-minute limits of the providers are respected (Q-Force waits and keeps a distance). Pseudonymization is applied before sending.
author: KuroShiro
